motion.scroll_reveal: Fade/translate sections in on scroll via IntersectionObserver adding a .in class; CSS transition only. Keep subtle (8-16px, 300-500ms).
motion.transitions: State changes 200-300ms ease; hover lifts/underlines on interactive affordances.
motion.hero: Optional ambient motion (image2video, slow parallax, gentle particle/canvas); never distracting.
motion.restraint: Motion supports reading; avoid gratuitous parallax, bouncing, or autoplaying carousels.

reduced_motion: Respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): disable non-essential transitions/animations and any autoplay motion; content must be fully usable static.

accessibility.contrast: Meet WCAG AA (>=4.5:1 body, >=3:1 large text) against --bg; check muted text and on-image text (use scrims).
accessibility.focus: Visible focus states on all interactive elements; logical tab order.
accessibility.keyboard: Buttons, sliders, card decks, quizzes operable by keyboard; use real <button>/<a> and aria where needed.
accessibility.alt_text: Meaningful alt for images; aria-labels for icon buttons and chart/map regions; caption charts.
accessibility.audio: Never autoplay sound; provide play/pause and a visual equivalent; mobile play targets >=44x44px.

performance: Inline data and styles; lazy-load images (loading=lazy) and heavy embeds.
Limit CDNs to what's used (Vega-Embed, Leaflet, optionally D3/PDF.js).
Keep the file self-contained and working on file:// (no fetch()).
